kjv: It is good for a man not to touch a woman
mine: It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman.
note: Most interpreters take this as a Corinthian ascetic slogan that Paul qualifies in 7:2–5; the KJV gives it as Paul's own maxim.

kjv: that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer
mine: that you may devote yourselves to prayer
note: TR adds "te nesteia kai"; absent from P11, P46, Sinaiticus*, A, B, C, D, F, G. One of several ascetic additions of "fasting" in the TR.

kjv: toward his virgin … let him do what he will … let them marry
mine: toward his betrothed … let them marry
note: parthenos autou is most likely a fiancée (an engaged couple deciding whether to marry); the KJV's "his virgin" with 7:38 "giveth her in marriage" has led to readings about a father and his daughter.
